sentences.text: Counsel
for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.

At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant submits that due to typographical error, Section 467 I.P.C. has been left to be transcribed in the memo and prayer clause of instant application, as such, he may be permitted to incorporate the same during the course of the day.
Learned counsel for the State has no objection to the contention aforesaid.
Prayer is allowed.
Learned counsel for the applicant is permitted to incorporate Section 467 I.P.C. in the memo and prayer clause of instant application during the course of the day.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Aniruddh Kumar Singh-I, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant application has been filed with the prayer to set aside the impugned order dated 3.12.2022 in Case No.1735 of 2011 under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. Police Station Tulsipur, District Balrampur (State of U.P. Vs. Mansha Ram Yadav) pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Balrampur.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was working as a Lekhpal and he retired in the year 2016.
He is a law abiding citizen and has never committed any offence.
Non bailable warrant has been issued against the applicant which is under challenge in the instant application.
He has explained his non appearance in para 3 of the application.
Adding his arguments, he submits that he may be permitted to appear before the trial court to move appropriate application.
On the other hand, learned A.G.A. for the State has no objection to the contention aforesaid.

In view of aforesaid submissions, the applicant is permitted to appear before the trial court by moving the proper application within a period of seven days from today, the same shall be decided within a further period of 30 days, strictly in accordance with law.
For a period of two weeks only, the order of N.B.W. shall remain stayed.
With the aforesaid observations, the application is disposed off.
